This incident is now resolved. We have now shifted traffic back to the NYC region. 

This issue was identified to be caused by a routing problem at an upstream Internet Exchange provider, which impacted connectivity and cascaded to our services.

To minimize customer impact, we temporarily rerouted traffic to our Washington, DC region. Once the issue was confirmed to be resolved by our upstream partner, traffic was safely restored to the NYC region.

An issue was identified affecting our DoH service that may have impacted customers in the London region. This did NOT affect DNS1/DNS2 UDP/TCP/TLS/DoT services. We identified the fault on Tuesday the 25th and resolved the it by 20:00 UTC by updating all affected servers. 

In addition, we have improved our monitoring and automation by adding a new failsafe to avoid this from happening again in the future.
